title: Ross Stores Finishes Its Plan for 115 New Stores

source.author: Jennifer Braun
source.title: Ross Stores completes 2026 expansion plan with 115 new locations

figures.quote: opened 51 stores across its Ross Dress for Less and dd's Discounts banners in September and October

figures.text: 41 Ross Dress for Less, 10 dd's Discounts, 17 states
figures.quote: added 41 Ross Dress for Less stores and 10 dd's Discounts locations across 17 states
completing its store expansion plans for fiscal 2026 ... bringing its total store openings for the year to 115

figures.text: first stores in Massachusetts; more in New York
figures.quote: The latest openings include Ross Dress for Less' first stores in Massachusetts ... further expansion in New York and other existing markets

figures.text: dd's Discounts core markets California, Florida, Texas
figures.quote: dd's Discounts continued to expand in its core markets of California, Florida and Texas

figures.text: Richard Lietz, executive vice president, property development
figures.quote: Each new opening allows us to deliver compelling value to even more customers ... while creating new jobs and making a positive impact in local communities

figures.text: Boys & Girls Clubs and First Book
figures.quote: also made donations to local Boys & Girls Clubs and First Book literacy partners

figures.text: about 2,377 stores in 45 states, DC, Guam, Puerto Rico
figures.quote: currently operate approximately 2,377 stores combined across 45 US states, the District of Columbia, Guam and Puerto Rico

figures.text: at least 2,900 Ross Dress for Less, 700 dd's Discounts, no date
figures.quote: aims to eventually expand its Ross Dress for Less network to at least 2,900 locations ... its dd's Discounts footprint to 700 stores

figures.text: off-price retailer; branded goods at discounted prices
figures.quote: consumers continue to seek branded merchandise at discounted prices
